products.name: Weave Router 2.0
products.description: Use Claude models in Codex and GPT models in Claude Code on your existing plans, routed to whichever has quota left. Weave Router 2.0 routes each coding agent request to the cheapest model that can get it right. On Terminal-Bench 4.0 and SWE-Atlas it matches GPT-6 Astra at half the cost, 2x faster. Powered by a new classifier that scores task complexity and cache-aware switching that only moves when savings beat the rebuild cost.

products.name: Appwrite 2.0
products.tagline: The open-source cloud for agents and developers
products.description: Appwrite 2.0 is the second major generation of the platform. It replaces the engine underneath, rebuilds the Console on top, and expands what a project can hold: relational, schemaless, and vector data, native PostgreSQL and MySQL engines, S3-addressable storage, an OAuth 2.1 and OIDC-compliant identity provider, and the network layer in front of all of it.

products.name: Gemini 3.8 & 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
products.tagline: Our most advanced Gemini Audio models yet
products.description: Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking are our most advanced live dialogue models yet, built for natural conversation.

products.name: Toki Coordination
products.tagline: Your personal assistant to schedule + follow up on meetings
products.description: Stop wasting 3 days scheduling a 30 minute group meeting or starting over every time someone cancels. Like a real executive assistant, Toki will email attendees, negotiate a time that works for everyone, follow up if needed, and send out invites. Toki will also help protect your time, architect your schedule, remember your preferences, and help you prioritize your most important tasks and urgent deadlines. And instead of paying tens of thousands, it's now free.

products.name: CAT ME app
products.tagline: See yourself or your friends as cats
products.description: The Cat Me app turns a photo of a person into their very own cat lookalike!  It’s simple and purr-fect:  1. Snap a picture of yourself or a friend. 2. Create a unique cat that matches their look and personality.  3. Share your new kitty with your crew. Each Purrtrait is generated by AI based on the original photo, transforming human features, expressions, hairstyles, and accessories into a one-of-a-kind cat. What would you look like as a cat?

products.name: Expand Board for macOS
products.tagline: Expand ideas, concepts, and plans across limitless boards
products.description: Expand is a spatial board for macOS. Place text, images, files, and shapes on an open canvas, then nest boards you can actually go into. Double-click the board to add something. Right-click to choose text, images, files, or shapes. The plus in the toolbar adds from the top of the window. Drag to arrange. Open a board to work inside it, then use the title-bar breadcrumbs to go back up.

products.name: Thread
products.tagline: AI journal that connects your thoughts into something bigger
products.description: Thread is an AI journal and second brain for capturing thoughts, ideas, notes, and voice recordings. It automatically connects related memories, finds patterns in your thinking, and turns scattered ideas into meaningful threads. Capture anything in seconds, rediscover what matters, and turn your thoughts into actionable ideas with a private AI-powered memory system.

products.name: Twigg
products.tagline: The context layer you never have to build
products.description: Twigg is a stateful API for calling LLMs. Instead of rebuilding and resending your whole conversation on every request, you create a chat once and send only the next event. Twigg holds the state: it fits context to the target model's schema, compacts or truncates when it runs long, and routes the call. Control tool schemas, system prompts and context windows from the dashboard, and track usage and billing. Build anything from personal agents to enterprise apps. You never manage context again.

products.name: ZeroClick
products.tagline: Sell your product to AI agents
products.description: ZeroClick helps businesses sell to AI agents. Turn your API or product into a storefront AI agents can discover and buy from, with payments, pricing controls, and transaction tracking in one place. Free to start, with help getting set up.

products.name: Fide Island
products.tagline: Media, Notes, on-device translation + more in your Notch
products.description: Turn your MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island for media, Apple Notes, on-device translation, calendar, files, clipboard and quick tools with Fide Island.

products.name: Jottoo
products.tagline: AI meeting notes that turn into tracked tasks
products.description: Jottoo turns meetings and notes into organised, deadline-tracked tasks — automatically. Record, upload, or type — no bot joins your call, nothing to install. Ask Jottoo anything about a past meeting and get the answer instantly. One flat plan, $13.99/month

products.name: Project Feed
products.tagline: Project management with built-in file review
products.description: Project Feed is a workspace for game developers, design teams and agencies. Share updates, plan tasks, edit docs and work on canvases together. Review images, video, audio, PDFs, 3D models, Rive files and sprite sheets. Turn feedback into tasks that link back to the review. Clients can approve selected updates or request changes in a portal. Includes chat, time tracking and analytics. Pro adds integrations and full API, CLI and MCP access. Free for up to 3 editors.

products.name: flat.social
products.tagline: Absurdly delightful 3D spaces where remote teams hang out
products.description: A playful virtual space for team socials, events and classes. Spatial audio, mini games and no downloads. Free for up to 5 people, right in the browser.

products.name: Convo
products.tagline: The AI copilot for people who sell
products.description: Convo helps you win more deals by giving the right support while the conversation is happening. Handle objections, catch buying signals, ask the right questions and get instant answers from your company knowledge. After every call, Convo captures the risks, next steps and follow-ups so nothing that could move the deal forward gets missed.

products.name: CreatorHat
products.tagline: YouTube SEO tools for Safari featuring Apple Intelligence
products.description: Find videos outperforming their channels, research YouTube keywords, and track your search rankings without leaving Safari. While your video uploads, CreatorHat transcribes it on your Mac and uses Apple Intelligence to suggest titles and a description inside YouTube Studio. Your transcript and AI writing stay on your Mac. $29.99/year after a 7-day trial, with no separate AI bill. Requires macOS 26+; AI features need Apple Intelligence.
